$comment: Copy this file to config-local.json and adjust for your environment. Only fields you specify will override the defaults.
Browser telemetry via OpenTelemetry. Omit the whole block to send nothing.

Spans go to the same collector as the WebAPI Java agent, so nothing leaves the deployment. endpoint is same-origin by default (Caddy proxies /otlp to the gateway), which avoids CORS and keeps the collector off any public port.

scrubUrlQueryStrings is ON whenever omitted and is only disabled by a literal false. Atlas puts free-text concept searches and filter values in query strings, so switching it off is a deliberate act with a privacy review behind it.
Unlike DOM-autocapture analytics, OTel never reads element text, so cohort and concept names cannot leak through page content.
